title: cyperus ferax var. acicularis
intro: Cyperus ferax var. acicularis, commonly known as Needle Sedge, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Needle Sedge include antipyretic, antiarthritic, and antispasmodic effects, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating fever and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
